candidate.scope: every non-workspace dependency; workspace crates keep the debug profile

method.samples_per_arm: 3 clean, 3 rebuild for each of the two decision-grounding arms (opt0_baseline, opt1_candidate), freshly re-run together as a matched pair; opt2_rejected_arm retains its original 3 clean, 2 rebuild samples from a since-merged branch revision, carried for context only and excluded from the accepted comparison
method.isolation: one freshly created CARGO_TARGET_DIR per sample, removed after its measurements
method.serialization: the host-wide CARGO_CI_BUILD_LOCK shared with scripts/cargo-ci.sh
method.clean_sample: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, then cargo test --workspace --no-run, timed separately
method.rebuild_sample: an equivalent completed clean build, one fixed comment-only probe appended to crates/jit/src/lib.rs, then a second timed cargo test --workspace --no-run
method.arms_differ_only_by: the presence and value of the manifest key under test

fixed_revision.note: The two decision-grounding arms were re-run one commit apart: opt1_candidate at 7f577e31 (still HEAD when that arm started), opt0_baseline at 3514acf4 (HEAD after an intervening commit). `git diff --stat 7f577e313 3514acf422` touches only dev/active/4b7c06d0-test-suite-performance/progress.json, no code and no manifest change, so the two arms remain a matched pair. opt2_rejected_arm was measured earlier at 14513e48d and 4ce93b361 on a since-merged branch; see raw/opt2-screen-*.json.

ceilings.source: the fixed maximum regression the prior compiler-optimization screens jit:7a2fc6f6 and jit:b883f916 were judged against
ceilings.target_directory_bytes_source: dev/TESTING.md, fresh validation target directory acceptance threshold

suite_runtime.method: already-built warm workspace runs with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 and CARGO_CI_NO_SCCACHE=1, measuring exactly the named suite clock of scripts/cargo-ci.sh

decision.reason: Both dependency optimization levels clear every fixed ceiling and both reach the suite bounds, and opt-level 1 is at least as fast at runtime while costing about half the build regression of opt-level 2.
